method: Reused historical source OCR, image evidence and saved comparison results with their identities.
Captured new rendered Kindle pages only to fill demonstrated source gaps or verify continuations.
Applied image-backed corrections; preserved registered identities and canonical references where the book conflicts with primary evidence.
Synchronized master, letter shards, existing curated records, and search-index identity changes.
limitations: A supported source match or OCR agreement is not an independent visual proofread of every word.
No supported match does not establish that a cultivar is absent from the book. Those descriptions were retained.
Reader footers and historical OCR filenames are source references; image contents and hashes establish the actual cultivar evidence.
Evidence images remain local and are not included in the website changes.
